name: Absurd!
source:
The fence, the trailer, the clowns. Will you be able to survive?

Some say the grass is greener on the other side, but what is lurking over the fence, is up to you to find out or die trying. 

A quirky, silly and absurd story of someone trying to find meaning in this strange world.

[From [url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/absurd]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
栅栏、拖车、小丑。你能活下来吗？

有人说另一边的草更绿，但栅栏外潜藏着什么，就取决于你去发现或尝试去死。

一个离奇、愚蠢和荒唐的故事，讲述了一个人试图在这个奇怪的世界中寻找意义的故事。

[来自[url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/absurd]Itch.io[/url]]
